# ScalablePerturbationLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning rule that updates reservoir weights using random perturbations and a scalar error signal, scaled to handle large networks without backpropagation. Enables online self-supervised adaptation in neuromorphic hardware where gradient computation is costly or unavailable.
